title: Early adopter transition playbook and feedback closure cadence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an executable playbook to transition select lighthouse accounts and graduated beta customers into 'early adopter' status. The playbook must tie acceptance criteria, release notes coordination, cross-team responsibilities (Eng, Design, Support, Sales, CSM), and a closed-loop feedback cadence so we can convert pilot success into long-term retention and measurable product improvements.
objectives: Define operational steps to graduate a customer from pilot to early-adopter
Establish a repeatable release-notes and comms workflow for pilot-impacting features
Create a feedback closure loop so customers see action on reported issues and suggestions
success_metrics: >60% of lighthouse accounts converted to early-adopter within 90 days of graduation
Median time from customer-reported issue to documented triage <= 72 hours
>70% customer satisfaction with onboarding experience (CSAT survey)
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document with step-by-step runbook checked into Confluence and accessible to GTM and Eng
One cross-functional run-through (warroom simulation) completed with notes and identified gaps
Release notes template and owner matrix approved by PM and Docs; automated link inserted into release pipeline
Feedback-to-product closure policy documented and integrated with Zendesk/GitHub labels so customers receive status updates
launch_checklist: Identify candidate lighthouse + graduated beta accounts and owners (PM, CSM)
Draft customer-specific onboarding email and support playbook
Schedule kickoff & success criteria sync with account stakeholders
Lock release notes copy and confirm PR owners
Prepare rollback/fallback plan and escalation contacts
feedback_flow: Customer reports issue -> CSM triage and tags ticket 'pilot-impact' -> Support creates GitHub issue linked to feature flag and PM owner
PM reviews triage weekly in feedback sync and assigns priority; ENG creates fix or workaround ticket
PM updates customer with status (Acknowledged -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Verified) within defined SLA
Monthly synthesis report to customers describing changes made from feedback
roles_and_owners: PM: owner of playbook, coordinates release notes and prioritization
CSM: account comms, Customer acceptance sign-off
ENG: implements fixes and provides technical runbook for on-call
Design: UX review and prototype approvals for customer-facing flows
Support: ticket triage and SLA enforcement
Docs: release notes publishing and archive
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: customers perceive slow response to feedback -> Mitigation: set and communicate clear triage SLAs and create a visible status board
Risk: release notes miss pilot-impacting changes -> Mitigation: enforce pre-release checklist and sign-off by PM + Docs
Risk: resource contention across multiple pilots -> Mitigation: prioritize by customer strategic value and use Dedicated capacity reservations when needed
release_notes_coordination: PM to provide feature synopsis and sample customer impact notes 5 business days before release
Docs to publish 'Pilot Impact' callout in release notes and add tracking tag
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Pilot graduation for 3 lighthouse accounts (weeks 2-4)
measurement_and_dashboards: Adopt 'Pilot Conversion' dashboard in Console showing per-account status, onboarding time, and CSAT
Add telemetry for time-to-first-successful-inference and error rate per account during onboarding
Weekly spike report of pilot-impacting exceptions routed to SRE and Eng leads
communication_plan: Customer-facing monthly update email summarizing top fixes and roadmap impacts
Ad-hoc status Slack thread for major incidents tagged #pilot-incident
post_launch_tasks: Collect 30/60/90 day retention signals for converted accounts
Run customer interviews for qualitative feedback and to build case studies
Update onboarding templates based on observed friction points
